names.zh-Hans: 卡尔博纳拉意面小菜单

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在罗马吃过意面后补画的菜单。面条旁边点了黑胡椒，背面写着“叉子走在前面”。
descriptions.en: My menu after carbonara in Rome, with pepper dots beside the pasta. The back records that the fork went ahead.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在罗马尝过炸饭团后画的两半点心，中间连着一条细细的奶酪线。
descriptions.en: Two halves of a supplì I tried in Rome, joined on my menu by one fine line of mozzarella.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在罗马斗兽场外数拱门时，邮包扣响了一声。我忘了数目，便在自己纸上记下重新看的位置。
descriptions.en: My mailbag buckle interrupted an arch count outside Rome's Colosseum. This personal note marks where to look again.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 尝过罗马的苏普利后，我把两半点心之间的奶酪细线画在纸上。带走的是画，点心已经吃好了。
descriptions.en: A line I drew after mozzarella stretched between the halves of my supplì in Rome. The drawing traveled; the snack was eaten.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 参观罗马万神殿后，我在外面写的第一句话。纸上记的是自己望向天窗后的一小段停顿。
descriptions.en: The first sentence I wrote outside the Pantheon in Rome, keeping a small pause after looking toward the oculus.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我为罗马万神殿那次抬头做的折卡。三个点下面留着一行空白，展开才看得见，不是建筑图。
descriptions.en: My homemade card for a moment under the Pantheon's dome in Rome. A blank line hides beneath three dots until unfolded; it is no architectural plan.
